svg.title: CrossTwin — System Overview
svg.text: Django + PostGIS digital twin for Dutch urban data (EPSG:28992), with a separate TiTiler process for raster tiles
80 models · GeometryField & RasterField (srid 28992) · GiST indexes · pg_stat_statements
Signals keep derived data consistent: population & urban-area cascade,
watersupply indicator chain, raster → COG export, layer cache bumps.
